decisions.reason: The coolant pressure booster extends the firm's core coolant management offering, so keeping it costs little while its market value is still uncertain after only one year.
The cleaning centrifuge complements the modular coolant filtration systems, and one year of evidence is too early to justify abandoning a cheap option.
Coolant nozzles are a low-cost add-on to existing systems, so the option is cheap to hold and supports system sales.
The scraper belt chip conveyor sits very close to the established conveyor business, has low incremental cost and is still visibly marketed.
The magnetic belt conveyor rounds out the chip conveyor range for metalworking customers, and nothing so far signals that its value won't be realized.
The hinged belt conveyor is a core product type with shared production and service infrastructure, so keeping it open costs little.
